Name: AeroCore
Author: tlitookilakin
Description:
[size=6][b]This mod is now retired. It is not compatible with 1.6 and no support will be offered.[/b][/size]

AeroCore is a coremod used by some of my other mods. Mostly, it's just code, but there are a few features available to users:

- Cursor Light: A small, square light that lights up the tile you're currently hovering over. Press a configurable hotkey to turn it on and off.
- Place item in world: Press a configurable hotkey to place the currently held item on the floor.
- More lighting quality options: Adds two new higher-quality options for lighting quality.
- Lighting flicker fix: reduces flickering and artifacts from high-detail lighting.

Options can be configured via GMCM.
